system.description:
Start the story with a companion (human, animal or other) tracked on its own character sheet: 8 Health Points, Average Speed, 3 Core Skill Points in every Core Skill, 1 weapon. It can't wear armour, use your abilities or bank Luck, but you may spend your Luck Points on its checks.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.51
